kultivator.screen.help.meditation.title: Meditation
kultivator.screen.help.meditation: Sit still on the ground and press the meditate key. While you meditate your qi refills six times faster and you gather cultivation every second. Moving, taking damage, attacking or using an item ends it. Spiritual sites multiply the gain: mountain peaks above height 120, cherry groves, an active beacon nearby, amethyst around you, the End, and a full moon under open sky. Amethyst qi-gathering formations around your seat help even more: the Blocks of Amethyst go level with the block you sit on, 3 blocks away in each direction. Every place has a qi density that thins while you meditate there and slowly recovers.
kultivator.screen.help.xp.title: Gathering cultivation
kultivator.screen.help.xp: Cultivation comes from slaying monsters (bosses give far more), mining ores without Silk Touch, meditating, eating pills and moments of enlightenment. Your root grade, good breakthrough qualities and spiritual sites multiply it; a Qi Deviation halves it.
kultivator.screen.help.bottleneck.title: Bottleneck and Stored Qi
kultivator.screen.help.bottleneck: When the bar fills below Peak you rise one stage by yourself. At the Peak stage the bar stops: you have reached a bottleneck. Everything you gather from then on becomes Stored Qi. It is never lost, and after a successful breakthrough it flows into your new realm.
kultivator.screen.help.breakthrough: With a full bar at a bottleneck, use the Breakthrough talisman. A mortal first needs a tested spiritual root, and the awakening always succeeds. Qi Refining to Foundation Establishment is a roll of fate after a short gathering of qi, which moving more than six blocks away or taking damage interrupts. Every step from Foundation Establishment upward calls down a Heavenly Tribulation. Each breakthrough is graded Cracked, Normal, Perfect or Heavenly, and a better grade makes you stronger.
kultivator.screen.help.tribulation.title: Heavenly Tribulation
kultivator.screen.help.tribulation: Dark clouds gather over you, then lightning strikes again and again. Each strike takes a share of your health that no armour can block, but it never kills: a strike that would have killed you makes the tribulation fail instead, leaving you with a Qi Deviation (or, in hardcore, one realm lower). Stay within six blocks of where you began. In the Nether the heavens send fire, in the End the void.
kultivator.screen.help.protectors.title: Dao Protectors
kultivator.screen.help.protectors: The upheaval draws monsters to your tribulation in waves. Friends, pets and sect mates nearby can fight them off for you: they are your Dao protectors. Whatever is left vanishes when the tribulation ends. They are drawn by the heavens, not hunted, so they give only half the usual cultivation.
kultivator.screen.help.pills.title: Pills
kultivator.screen.help.pills: Golden carrots, glow berries, honey, golden apples and other rare things work as pills: eat them, or sneak and use the ones that are not food. Every pill leaves toxicity behind, which fades slowly. A poisoned body gains less from pills and falls sick once toxicity passes 80.
kultivator.screen.help.techniques.title: Techniques
kultivator.screen.help.techniques: Arts are learned on reaching a realm, on choosing a Dao, or by comprehending an enchanted book (sneak and use it). Select one on the Techniques tablet or with the previous and next keys, then cast it with the cast key. Techniques spend qi and only ever strike monsters.
kultivator.screen.help.roots.title: Spiritual Root
kultivator.screen.help.roots: A mortal first tests their spiritual root with the Test spiritual root talisman: an eight-second ceremony of rising stones reveals one to five elements and a grade, from Trash through Low, Mid and High to Heavenly. The root is set for life and only a Marrow Cleansing Pill can raise its grade. A better grade multiplies all cultivation (from ×0.6 up to ×1.7), raises your max qi and your chance at Foundation Establishment. Fewer elements make a purer root, and an element matching your Dao speeds its comprehension by half.
kultivator.screen.help.dao.title: Dao and Dao Comprehension
kultivator.screen.help.dao: From Golden Core you choose one Dao for life on the Root & Dao tablet: Sword, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Body, Life, Shadow & Wind or Space. It teaches its Dao art at once, and from Nascent Soul its book art can be learned from an enchanted book. Dao Comprehension grows from 0 to 100%% by casting your Dao's arts, deeds fitting your Dao, meditating at a fitting place, enlightenment, good breakthroughs, technique books and sparring wins. It multiplies technique damage up to ×2, and at 90%% you reach the Dao Domain.
kultivator.screen.help.alchemy.title: Alchemy
kultivator.screen.help.alchemy: Any cauldron standing on a lit campfire or soul campfire is an Alchemy Furnace; the blocks are only looked at and never changed. Right-click it with an ingredient to put one into the pot (at most 10). With both hands empty, right-click to look inside; sneak and right-click with an empty hand to refine for 10 seconds. Only the exact ingredients of a recipe make pills, which pop out beside the cauldron. The success chance is 60%% plus 4%% per alchemy level, more on soul fire and for the Fire Dao (at most 95%%), and the pill grade runs from Low to Perfect.
kultivator.screen.help.heart_demon.title: Heart Demon
kultivator.screen.help.heart_demon: Before the tribulations to Nascent Soul, Dao Union and True Immortal, a dark copy of yourself appears. Heart demon pressure from failed breakthroughs, heavy pill toxicity and much killing can also call one forth. Defeat it within 120 seconds. If your health falls below 20%% the blow is held back and you lose instead of dying, which leaves a Qi Deviation. Victory clears the pressure, grants cultivation and improves your next breakthrough.
kultivator.screen.help.beasts.title: Spirit Beasts
kultivator.screen.help.beasts: Feed a Spirit Beast Pill to a wolf you tamed or a fox that trusts you (bone, glow berries, amethyst shard and golden carrot). Further pills and the monsters it helps slay give spirit XP, and the beast evolves through three tiers: tier 2 needs you at Golden Core, tier 3 at Nascent Soul. Evolved wolves call moonlit thunder and foxes bite with foxfire; at tier 3 both bless their master. A spirit beast only attacks what your techniques may strike.
kultivator.screen.help.formations.title: Protective Formation
kultivator.screen.help.formations: Place a Lodestone with four Crying Obsidian exactly four blocks to the north, south, east and west, level with it. Sneak and use the Lodestone with an Amethyst Shard to awaken it: each shard gives 10 minutes of power, up to 2 hours. While lit it drives monsters out of 16 blocks, and your tribulation strikes inside it are weaker. Sneak and use it with an empty hand to switch it off or on again.
kultivator.screen.help.sects.title: Sect Fellowship and Sparring
kultivator.screen.help.sects: A sect with disciples is founded with the Sect Hall Stele (see the Sect Hall topic). /sect (or /sekte) only forms a Sect Fellowship: a group of players, without disciples and without a hall. Form one with /sect create <name>, then invite other players. Fellows meditating within 16 blocks of each other gather a little faster, and they guard each other's tribulations as Dao protectors. Challenge any nearby player to sparring with /sect spar: after a countdown you fight for 120 seconds, and a blow that would leave someone below 10%% health ends the match instead, so nobody dies. Sparring (and sparring with a wanderer in town) now uses the Sword Duel clash mechanics: parries, Posture and the Deathblow (see the Sword Duel topic). A real victory teaches some cultivation and Dao Comprehension.
kultivator.screen.help.ascension.title: Acknowledged by Heaven
kultivator.screen.help.ascension: When you reach True Immortal, the heavens acknowledge you once: the sky darkens, a pillar of golden light descends and the heavens open for half a minute. Leaving, dying or changing dimension calls it off without any harm, and it comes again later. Its gifts last forever: no Qi Deviation can take hold of you, your body slowly heals itself, and your aura turns to shifting rainbow light with drifting petals.
kultivator.screen.help.visuals.title: Effect Quality and cosmetics
kultivator.screen.help.visuals: On the Settings tablet, Effect Quality sets how many particles you see: Minimal (a quarter), Normal or Maximal (double, with extra flourishes). It only changes your own screen. Everyone sees your aura, Robe, the sword on your back, glowing eyes and Dao Circle; switch each one off for yourself with the jade coins or /cultivate visual <part> on|off.
kultivator.screen.help.keys.title: Keys
kultivator.screen.help.commands: Commands: /cultivate (or /kultivasi) shows your path; /cultivate meditate, breakthrough, hardcore on|off and visual <part> on|off do the same as this scroll. Also: root test, dao choose <dao>, technique select <id>, alchemy recipes and alchemy level, beast list, formation list, panduan (the Guide Book), peta (the World Map), duel (the Sword Duel: screen, challenge, disciples), perguruan or sekte (the Living Sect; each of its parts has its own sub-commands), and /sect (or /sekte) for the Sect Fellowship and sparring.
